# How to Restore Old Photos with Codex MCP and Medux

Codex MCP and Medux tutorial for restoring old photos, from local image upload to restoration task submission, status tracking, and repaired image download.

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_photo_repair`

## Prompt

```text
Using the connected Medux MCP server, restore OLD_PHOTO in this workspace. Repair scratches, fading, and contrast while preserving identity and composition. Inspect and upload the image, show me the photo-repair arguments, then wait for my approval. After approval, monitor the task, save the result locally, and compare its dimensions with the source.
```
